methodology: All 78 company/category URLs were independently reviewed on Nov 2 using primary-source direct retrieval and issuer-specific searches; checked_at is the audit finalization timestamp, not an individual HTTP-request time. Directly inaccessible, stale-only, dynamically empty or incomplete issuer archives remain incomplete even if an individual event is separately verified. Exact times are never inferred. Source status is not carried forward without a fresh attempt.
